scope: Actual local browser against the existing Windows Docker PostgreSQL app, with current frontend served by Vite on loopback. This is not authenticated public-URL acceptance.
method: CUA browser forms, navigation, accessibility observations, screenshots and read-only rendered DOM inspection. No injected fetch or React state mutation.

observations.detail: Selected original loop logo, public neutral document illustration, two real account fields, visible focus and no patient preview.
390x844 viewport, both fields and Sign in fit without horizontal page overflow.
One incorrect local password produced the actual rejection message; correct existing credentials then opened the app. Passwords are not recorded.
Actual scoped open tasks, patient reference names, document version/date and source excerpt displayed; no prototype rows were inserted.
An unmatched search displayed the empty-filter state and 0/8 loaded tasks; clearing it restored the real list.
Open document retained exact patient-001, encounter-001 and selected document identity; readable source and actual revision author appeared.
Switching to patient-002 with all encounters showed only its three authorized documents, clearing the previous document.
Patient change canonicalized URL and removed old record/task/encounter; reload retained patient-002; Back restored patient-001 exact encounter and source.
Opening navigation focused its first link; Escape closed it and restored trigger focus; main content was no longer inert.
390px layout kept rows usable, page width <= viewport and logout on one line.
Created one authored synthetic document and a fresh document_review task through existing typed forms at patient-001/encounter-001.
Existing pinned dr_train_ollama/Typhoon returned four present findings and one missing plan, with exact source quotes; no mock fallback.
Edited action text into immutable version2, approved that version, then committed through existing controls.
Reopened the exact task and selected the persisted proposal: version2 remained committed and edit/approve/reject/commit controls were disabled.
390px patient context, tabs and AI intake fit without horizontal page overflow; the committed action remained disabled.

post_test: Local clinician browser session logged out; temporary viewport reset. Server test01 and prior server records were not changed by this local workflow.
limits: Screenshots document visual observations during final refinement; deployed source and built assets are independently hash-bound. This is one synthetic integration run, not a clinical or throughput evaluation. All38 domains/J01-J10 were not rerun in this UI iteration.
